claims.text: The model is compared against several state-of-the-art models including MT-RNN, MT-CNN, and others, showing competitive or better performance in most tasks.
The model achieves an average improvement of 4.5% in the Multi-Domain scenario compared to existing state-of-the-art models.
The evaluation includes comparisons with state-of-the-art models across different benchmark datasets for text classification.
